environment: Built renderer served at http://127.0.0.1:4273; Chrome; previewBridge; CUA UI actions and accessibility observations
limitations: These observations verify renderer behavior. They do not verify Electron IPC, filesystem writes, model calls, or cloud behavior.

steps: Open a fresh preview session with the default Research Apps configuration.
Observe Choose your path and the four workflow cards.
Click Generate figures and read the resulting accessibility tree.
observations.observed: The page returns to Choose your path after Reproduce a paper. Generate figures leaves the same accessibility tree. No destination or explanation appears.

steps: Set the chat textbox to UNSENT_RESEARCH_PLAN_A — keep this question while exploring data.
Read the accessibility tree and confirm that exact value is present.
Open Data analysis and use its built-in Palmer Penguins dataset.
Enter ANALYSIS_HANDOFF_B — explain body mass differences by species. in Continue in research chat.
Click Continue in chat and inspect the resulting chat textbox.
observations.observed: The textbox contains ANALYSIS_HANDOFF_B plus the dataset summary and sample rows. UNSENT_RESEARCH_PLAN_A is absent. No confirmation dialog appears. Nothing was submitted to an agent.

cleanup: Used New research to return the preview chat to an empty draft after recording the overwrite scenario. No account sign-in or model request was performed.
